name: Shop
description: Sell physical, digital and service products from a Kohevo Studio site. Products (price, sale price with dates, images, SKU, stock with low-stock alerts, weight and size, categories, tags, upsells and cross-sells, and variants such as colour × size, each with its own SKU, stock, price, weight and size; digital products deliver their files through private download links), an importer for WooCommerce products, a cart kept in the visitor's session, guest checkout with shipping zones (flat, free, by weight, local pickup, or live carrier rates through EasyPost), tax included in prices or added by address (US sales tax), coupons, payment through the shared payment layer (Stripe, PayPal), and an orders screen with tracking, shipping labels, packing slips, fulfilment emails and refunds. Its Studio widgets (product grid, single product parts, cart, mini cart, checkout and order confirmation) are in Add › Components, and a Single template with the Products condition lays out /product/{slug}.
author: Kohevo

permissions.label: Create, edit and delete products and categories
Configure shop settings (shipping, tax, pages, addresses)
